body:
TMT dealmaking news: private equity buyouts, add-ons, exits and other deals in the sector.

VKE provides large-scale groundwork foundations, substructures and reinforced concrete frame packages for data center developments across Europe.

Leon Capital makes growth investment in VKE Group, a European data center infrastructure business; Eurazeo’s new sole-CEO Christophe Bavière spoke with PEI Private Equity about how the firm’s focus on the European mid-market is paying off; Truelink Capital agrees to acquire the global intrusion products business of Johnson Controls.

Cogenius, founded in 2012 and based in Deerlijk, Belgium, provides meter-to-cash software to smaller and growing energy suppliers.

Firms have plenty to weigh before they buy or build AI infrastructure, say Metal’s Taylor Lowe and Court Square’s Jessica Pizzo.

Our latest Sector Spotlight, on AI and the TMT sector, looking at how private equity firms are adapting to a new world where old assumptions and playbooks in software investing no longer apply; L Catterton invests in Glance, an AI-powered personal shopping platform; Pitchwise Holdings agrees to buy shares in Spanish soccer team Valencia CF.

The Bengaluru-based, InMobi-backed company uses agentic AI to recommend products to consumers across smartphones and connected TVs.

Apax, Clearlake, EQT, Francisco Partners, Hg, Permira, Thoma Bravo and Vista spoke with PEI Private Equity about defensible moats, AI-native companies and vibe coding.

3E is a provider of renewable energy asset performance management software and technical advisory services.

4ALLPORTAL is a Gütersloh-based provider of product information, digital asset and master data management software with more than 100 enterprise customers.

Stuart is a France-headquartered urban and last-mile logistics platform with revenues of approximately €50m.
